verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's `parse` endpoint explicitly supports uploading local PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, HTML and more to be converted into Markdown or structured JSON, directly matching the story's need to extract text from Office/PDF files without self-hosting infrastructure. This is documented in both product docs and SDK references, though there's no independent hands-on validation of extraction quality across all these formats specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of file-parsing accuracy, and explicit confirmation of PowerPoint (PPTX) support beyond the general 'and more' phrasing.
